_comment: Selbst gehostete Inventar- und Vermietungsverwaltung fuer Veranstaltungstechnik
name: Inventarverwaltung VT (Node 22)
author: fundus@example.com
description: Selbst gehostete Inventar- und Vermietungsverwaltung fuer Veranstaltungstechnik. Node.js + SQLite, keine externen Dienste.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y git ca-certificates curl

cd /mnt/server

BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-claude/equipment-rental-app-ideas-9gdoj4}"
REPO="${GIT_REPO:-https://github.com/Mart0034/Inventarverwaltung-VT.git}"

echo "Cloning ${REPO} (branch: ${BRANCH}) ..."
rm -rf /tmp/fundus-src
git clone --branch "${BRANCH}" --single-branch "${REPO}" /tmp/fundus-src
rm -rf /tmp/fundus-src/.git

# Overwrite app files with the latest version. The repo never contains a
# data/ directory, so this step never touches the persisted database.
cp -r /tmp/fundus-src/. /mnt/server/
rm -rf /tmp/fundus-src

npm install --omit=dev

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/cloudflared ]; then
  echo "Downloading cloudflared (for optional Cloudflare Tunnel HTTPS) ..."
  curl -L --fail -o /mnt/server/cloudflared https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-amd64
  chmod +x /mnt/server/cloudflared
fi

echo "Installation abgeschlossen."

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Welcher Branch des Repos beim (Neu-)Installieren geklont werden soll.

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel Token
variables.description: Optional. Token from a Cloudflare Tunnel connector (Zero Trust dashboard -> Networks -> Tunnels), used to expose this server over HTTPS via Cloudflare without opening any ports. Leave empty to skip.
